models.comment: Spectrogram equivalent of ultra deep and wide model. 6 layers with diamond channel pattern (128→256→64). Conservative pooling for feature preservation.
models.hypothesis: Very deep networks (6 layers) with diamond-shaped capacity learn hierarchical frequency-time features at multiple abstraction levels. Wide middle captures complex patterns.

models.comment: Spectrogram equivalent of multi-scale high-res model. Higher capacity with pyramid channels (96→192→96). Less aggressive pooling for high resolution.
models.hypothesis: Multi-scale frequency-time kernels capture features at multiple resolutions. Higher capacity improves localization accuracy.

models.comment: Spectrogram equivalent of wide shallow fast model. Only 3 layers with very wide kernels for efficient inference. Aggressive downsampling.
models.hypothesis: Wide frequency-time kernels (7×128 → 3×32) capture long-range patterns with minimal depth. Fast inference for real-time applications.

models.comment: Spectrogram equivalent of ResNet-inspired model. 8 layers with paired blocks (32-64-64, 128-128, 256-256, 512). Alternating stride/pool pattern. Small consistent 3×3 kernels in deeper layers.
models.hypothesis: ResNet-style depth with paired layers and gradual channel growth learns robust hierarchical spectro-temporal features. Small kernels preserve fine-grained frequency-time patterns.

models.comment: Spectrogram equivalent of multi-scale receptive model. Alternating small/large 2D kernels create diverse receptive fields. Small: (5×11, 3×9, 3×7), Large: (7×33, 5×27, 3×21). Mixed stride pattern for efficient downsampling.
models.hypothesis: Alternating frequency-time kernel sizes (small for local details, large for global context) capture multi-scale spectro-temporal patterns. Parallel processing of fine-grained and coarse-grained features improves localization.

models.comment: Spectrogram equivalent of aggressive early downsample model. Very aggressive first layer: stride(2×8) + pool(2×4) = 4×32 reduction! Then stride(2×4) = 8×128 total. Quick dimensionality reduction followed by high-capacity refinement (512 channels). Skips pooling on layers 1 and 3.
models.hypothesis: Early aggressive 2D downsampling reduces computation dramatically while large initial kernel (11×32) captures essential spectro-temporal patterns. Wide channels (512) compensate for spatial information loss. Efficient for real-time applications.

models.comment: Spectrogram equivalent of large receptive field model. Very large 2D kernels simulate dilated convolutions. Paired layers with decreasing sizes: (11×33, 9×33), (7×17, 5×17), (3×9, 3×9). Captures long-range frequency-time dependencies. Conservative pooling preserves spatial details.
models.hypothesis: Large 2D receptive fields (up to 11×33) capture long-range spectro-temporal dependencies spanning multiple harmonics and extended time windows. Simulates dilated convolutions for efficient multi-scale feature extraction without parameter explosion.

models.comment: Large time kernels for long-range patterns. Aggressive time pooling. Conservative freq pooling.
models.hypothesis: Speech has more temporal than spectral redundancy
